Jazz_Colby: Sometimes a person discovers unexpected talents and learns to make the most of them. Trevor is equally capable of repairing, starting and tuning anything or blowing it up, breaking into it and taking it apart. Engines, detonators and rifles make little difference to him. Trevor can turn absolutely anything into a lethal trap.
Jazz_Blade: Bill might have been nicknamed the Butcher if his knife work were not so surgically precise. He prefers blades to firearms: guns make far too much noise and make things far too easy. His proudest skill is carving the entire alphabet into a victim, or at least all the vowels, before they bleed to death.
Jazz_Ira: Ira led a humanitarian mission in Arulco during Queen Deidranna's reign. Horrified by the country's human rights abuses, this humanitarian and moralist picked up a rifle herself and joined Miguel Cordona's rebels. The Organization holds Miss Smythe's service during the conflict in the highest regard, particularly her personal assistance to its mercenaries as a first-rate guide, nurse and sentry.
Jazz_Dimitri: A rebel and revolutionary, Dimitri served in Miguel Cordona's resistance. Unfortunately, his forgetfulness kept him from making much of himself in postwar Arulco. He eventually decided to honor the promise he had made to the Organization's mercenaries after helping storm Deidranna's palace: I go with you. Guard any door you want.
Jazz_Madman: Kevin helped AIM and MERC mercenaries free of charge during the fighting in Arulco, mostly by putting his mechanical and repair skills to work. Eventually he decided to make a living at it and accepted Biff Apscott's offer of a job with MERC.
Jazz_Conrad: Lieutenant Conrad Gillitt got out just in time. During the Arulco crisis he served as an instructor for Deidranna's army at the elite training complex in Alma. By a remarkable coincidence, someone forgot to renew his contract, leaving him free to offer his command and training services to the Resistance with a clear conscience. After the fighting ended, MERC spared no expense in trying to recruit such a valuable specialist.
Jazz_Mike: Mike, no surname given, has earned his reputation as one of the Organization's most effective and expensive mercenaries. During the uprising in Arulco, however, he accepted Deidranna's invitation and fought on the opposing side. Let that be a lesson to him: even a lion can be brought down by a pack.
Jazz_Grom: Sergey Gromov joined AIM on the recommendation of his fellow serviceman Ivan Dolvich. For years he worked as the Organization's pilot, delivering mercenaries to their assignments and extracting them afterward. At the start of the operation to evacuate the Breakers team from Khalif Island, he was shot down with the squad he was carrying and joined them on the ground. The Organization has yet to acquire another helicopter, so he continues to take field assignments.
Jazz_Iggy: Mike recruited Iggy into Arulco's army for a punitive campaign against Miguel's rebels. Instead, Iggy defected to their side, bringing along a prototype of the latest secret weapon: a devastating multi-shot armor-piercing rocket launcher. After the fighting he offered his services to the Organization, and we saw no reason to refuse.
Jazz_Benny: Alexandra Benedict and her mentor Simon Grandier serve the Organization as members of the Breakers assassination team. Before the operation on Khalif Island, neither appeared on AIM's regular roster. The involvement of regular personnel in their evacuation compromised their cover, so both have temporarily been transferred to the public staff list, pending clarification.
Jazz_Simon: Mr. Grandier worked in the Organization's Breakers assassination team. A highly skilled contract killer and sniper, he used the arrangement to stay out of the law's reach. When a leak at the highest level of the Organization lured the Breakers to Khalif Island, Simon avoided arrest and later rejoined the main team. His efforts helped settle the conflict with the remnants of DFK. He was subsequently transferred to the regular roster on a temporary basis and became available for field assignments.
Jazz_Rothman: We had almost forgotten that one of Stephan's previous jobs involved organizing security at diamond mines in southern Africa. He may not know today's market conditions, but the general situation in Grand Chien is hardly a mystery to him. He spent several years in that world, and passing up his experience would be foolish.
Jazz_Quinten: Dr. Quinten is currently one of the Organization's most experienced field surgeons. At the very least, he has the unusual distinction of having personally deployed from a helicopter to treat the wounded during the memorable Storm in a Teacup operation. Danny works equally well alone or with almost any collection of teammates, so give him a closer look.
Jazz_Vicious: A rough-edged romantic from French Canada, Vicious started out as a nightclub bouncer and has been improving his close-combat skills ever since. A combined-arms operation with tanks and aircraft is hardly his natural habitat. But when it comes to beating someone's brains out at arm's length or shotgun range, he has few equals.
Jazz_Biff: Biff Apscott and a MERC squad managed to plunge themselves into an exceptionally deep pile of shit. As if anyone were surprised. The squad scattered, and its survivors were pinned down in the mountains north of the Adjani valley, forcing AIM to rescue the competition. After his evacuation, Mr. Apscott recovered somewhat, reassessed the situation in Grand Chien and expressed an interest in working with AIM. Africa is a big place. There is room for everyone.
Jazz_Nervous: Killing is Frankie's specialty. He is more interested in the process than the result. He may not be a sniper, but he is highly proficient with automatic weapons. The same can be said of his skill with blades.
Jazz_Flo: A winemaker's daughter, Florence spent most of her childhood in the Cognac region of France. After moving to Pittsburgh in the United States, she became an accountant for an arms dealer, where she acquired extensive knowledge of firearms. She is quick-witted but somewhat lacking in confidence, which is why she is underpaid.
Jazz_Cougar: One of the few cadets to earn top marks in every final examination. It should be noted, however, that his father wrote the examination program. Jim is proficient in the full range of military skills and particularly good with automatic weapons. A true professional, he may be the finest mercenary in M.E.R.C.
Jazz_Miguel: Miguel Cordona led the Resistance against Deidranna's regime for many years. After its fall and the restoration of Arulco's rightful king, Chivaldori, Miguel realized that he had secured a peaceful life for his people, but not for himself. That is how he came to serve the Organization. Turning down a field commander with such extensive experience, from sabotage to combined-arms operations, would have been sheer stupidity.
Jazz_Gamos: Gamos is an unassuming native of Metavira whose path keeps crossing AIM's. First he guided its mercenaries around his home island. Then he briefly worked as a mercenary himself in Gus Tarballs' operations against DFK. Later, by some unexplained turn of events, the Organization encountered him during the Arulco crisis behind the wheel of a stolen van. Now this likable fellow wants to work for AIM again and see the world. We could hardly deny him that small favor.
Jazz_Dynamo: Dynamo was a genuine political prisoner of Deidranna's regime. His wife and son were executed without trial, and he was sent to a prison that made Alcatraz look like a health resort. When the Resistance captured it and freed the inmates, Gregory had no reason left to live except revenge against Deidranna. Once that was done, Greg offered his services to MERC. As he put it, this death would be as good as any other. An unsettling thing to hear.
Jazz_Gaston: An outstanding member of the French Marine Corps, Gaston played a vital role in numerous NATO and UN operations across this hostile world. Confident, combat-tested and a professional sniper, Gaston Cavalier represents another step in M.E.R.C.'s commitment to meeting your needs.
Jazz_Horg: Lieutenant Horg is built like a tank and fights like one too. Exceptionally skilled with heavy weapons, Cigar spent the last two years working as an independent mercenary in the Congo. He is one of the most formidable and respected men in his field, and M.E.R.C. is proud that he chose us as his first agency, even if only on a temporary trial basis.
Jazz_Manuel: Fatima's husband and Pacos's father, Manuel infiltrated Arulco's army on Miguel's orders and rose to sergeant. The crime boss Kingpin exposed him, forcing him to flee to neighboring Tracona. There the Organization's mercenaries recruited him during the Unfinished Business operation. Even after the war, he chose not to return to civilian life, convinced he could do more good with the Organization. We have no objections: few can match his camouflage and reconnaissance skills.
Jazz_Monk: Viktor Kolesnikov comes from Russia and is a genuine tough nut to crack. An automatic-weapons specialist, he prefers to work alone and wastes few words, earning him the nickname Monk. It suits this quiet professional. He is also an expert in camouflage. He cannot stand his compatriot Ivan. Having served in Chechnya, he is selective about his clients.
Jazz_Allik: Janno was born in Estonia to a German mother and served in the Soviet Army for many years. He enjoys cooking for friends and making the most of life, but this bear of a man's greatest passion is heavy weaponry. Locks are neither a problem nor an obstacle to him. He prefers working with his fellow Estonian Vilde, whom he met while serving in East Germany.
Jazz_Henning: Von Branitz comes from an old Prussian family. A true professional, he served in East Germany's army. After reunification, Henning became a mercenary and built a distinguished career. Early on he worked as a military adviser in Cuba; his list of postings is now a yard long. Give him an automatic rifle or a heavy weapon and he will not let you down. Henning despises New Age thinking, which makes Thor particularly hard for him to stomach.
Jazz_Static: Today's mercenaries may grow old and their children take their places, but Static will still be opening doors and hacking computers for them. AIM is simply unimaginable without him. He may no longer quite keep pace with modern warfare, but technological progress can do the running for him.
Jazz_Highball: Dr. Highball alternates between getting his act together and making a mess of it. Cliff has extensive experience in field surgery and trauma care, but without colleagues to debate with, he quickly grows bored. Still, as the saying goes, even a drink cannot wash away true skill.
Jazz_Bull: Mercenaries like Bull form the backbone of almost any operation of meaningful size. Dependable, quiet and as strong as his namesake, Bull readily tackles whatever job you give him. Granted, you would not give him every kind of job, but he can handle the essentials.
Jazz_Cord: Doug Milton was born and raised in Kentucky. Expelled from school in the fourth grade, he went to work at his father's gas station and became an excellent mechanic. After his sister took over his job, he wandered around the country and eventually decided to become a mercenary. His hobbies include shooting squirrels and collecting road signs.
Jazz_Hobbit: Tim knows his explosives and learns quickly. Remember, however, that a sapper cannot afford mistakes. Hillman might have stayed at Harvard to finish his degree in electromagnetic fields if not for a terrible depression, perhaps caused by electromagnetic radiation. His allergies make him prefer assignments in colder countries. Not that anyone asks him.
Jazz_Ricochet: Some people are simply unlucky with their looks. Tim Sutton is one of them. His dreadful haircut and neck tattoo have cost him many a contract. His resume is nevertheless impressive: martial arts, night operations, sniper training and medical training.
Jazz_Meat: Aside from his immense size, Thorton is known for being the first guard fired from an Alabama state prison for cruelty to inmates. We still do not know the details. We were afraid to ask.
Jazz_Carlos: Carlos was one of Miguel Cordona's closest advisers and comrades. When the war ended, he followed his patron into AIM. We all need a little depression and lowered expectations, don't we?
Jazz_Devin: Red hair. Irish. Sells explosives. What was he doing in civil-war-torn Arulco? Oh, right. Eventually Devin offered his services to the Organization and stayed on contract. Turnover among sappers is high. You cannot afford to throw them away.
Jazz_Shank: Mr. Druz ended up in the same Arulcan prison as Dynamo, though we never established why: Briem keeps rambling about plants and parents. Eventually, tired of scraping by on twenty-dollar odd jobs, he drifted into MERC. Oddly, he seems convinced that we pay him. As if MERC were some sort of drug den.
Jazz_Vince: A doctor from Cambria's hospital who decided, at some point, to lend the Arulcan Revolution a personal hand. His working conditions have hardly improved: instead of a poor but minimally equipped hospital, he now has an open field for an operating room and a spread-out greatcoat for a table. So far, he seems to like it.
Jazz_Hitman: The Organization met Mr. Ruthven in Arulco while Interpol was looking for him over a series of long-range sniper assassinations. The bounty hunter who passed us the contract insisted on receiving his head detached from his body. Mr. Ruthven naturally objected to that arrangement and made a counteroffer: he would work for AIM.
Jazz_Biggens: An aging British Army veteran, Biggens once traveled the world administering injections of imperialism and democracy, and has plenty of stories to tell about it. The Organization met him during the Unfinished Business operation in Tracona and successfully persuaded him to change employers. Bored in his later years, he is willing to share his invaluable experience with the younger generation.
Jazz_Kulba: John Kulba's luck has exactly two settings: all or nothing. He accidentally flew into a country in the middle of a civil war, then got out unharmed under armed escort. His wife developed incurable skin cancer, only to die quickly and without suffering during a robbery, though calling that good fortune is debatable. Grief-stricken, John made his way to a developing country, where he again met mercenaries he knew and decided to join them. He has nothing left to lose and will fight to the very end. His or the enemy's, whichever comes first.
Jazz_Vilde: Lennart is a natural leader whose confidence is infectious. His sense of humor, on the other hand, leaves much to be desired. Like Janno Allik, he comes from Estonia and has a German mother. A childhood in Siberia toughened him up, and his greatest strengths today are night operations and automatic weapons.
Jazz_Grace: Graziella Girelli is descended from Italian immigrants to the United States. She has never even visited Italy, yet her heritage is plain to see. However hard she tried to fit in as an American, she never quite managed it. What drove her into mercenary work remains unclear, but she has at least one useful combat skill: a well-practiced throwing arm. American baseball.
Jazz_Steiger: This former GSG-9 operative has only one weakness: Dr. Laura Colin, whom he met on a course in Lubeck. A consummate professional, he excels at night operations and can put a bullet through a squirrel's eye from a kilometer away. He also has a talent for instruction, though his manners leave much to be desired. He works well with Henning von Branitz, but Doug Milton is a red rag to a bull.
Jazz_Lucky: Luc Fabre comes from Belgium. His callsign seems almost a joke at the expense of his life. He grew up without a father and had a difficult childhood. When he learned that someone was harassing his little sister, he flew into a rage and broke the man's neck. His victim turned out to be an important person, forcing Luc underground and into mercenary work. This muscleman is a walking weapon. Dangerous enough in a fistfight, he becomes unstoppable with an automatic rifle.
Jazz_Laura: Laura Colin was born in Romania. Her dissident parents fled to Germany to avoid arrest, and she inherited their dislike of dictators. She studied medicine and joined A.I.M. on Rudolf Steiger's advice. An enthusiastic mercenary, she excels at tracking enemies and handling automatic weapons. She hates working with Louise Garneau.
Jazz_Eskimo: His past is obscure, and he does not like discussing it. A rebel who fought for Miguel, he was captured and thrown into Deidranna's Alma prison, where repeated brutal interrogations damaged his health. After his release he rejoined the Resistance. He may no longer be the man he once was, but his hand is still steady.
__note: Translations follow the supplied archive biographies, including its fictional events; no real-world factual claims are implied. Russian spelling repairs are applied by the profile preparation helper.
